title: A semi-implicit double-point Material Point Method for both free-surface flow and seepage in deformable porous media
summary: A new semi-implicit, two-phase, double-point formulation of the Material Point Method (MPM) for soil-water interaction with seepage and free-surface flows under large deformation is presented in this paper. The approach advances the water phase implicitly while keeping the soil phase explicit, enabling stable, efficient time integration in problems that involve rapid seepage and strong free-surface motion. The proposed framework models high-Reynolds-number interphase drag through a non-linear Darcy's law implemented for the first time within an incremental fractional step MPM formulation…
